# phron_ssh_key (Resource)

A saved SSH public key of the Organization, which Servers install at first boot. Servers already created with a key keep it when the key is deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "phron_ssh_key" "admin" {
  name       = "admin"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A name for the key. Changing it replaces the key.
- `public_key` (String) The OpenSSH public key. Changing it replaces the key.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) The key's fingerprint.
- `id` (String) The SSH key id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import phron_ssh_key.admin <ssh key id>
```
